Appreciate the clear asks. I've attached a draft MAP and a short term sheet to start procurement conversations. Key points up front (summary):

- Pilot window: 90 days (Kickoff week of Mar 1)
- Deliverables: infra provisioning in your VPC, sample workload onboarding, latency & cost baseline, acceptance criteria (SLA/throughput tests + sample eval prompts)
- Pricing: Pilot rate = usage-based (hosted engine) + waived platform fee during pilot (see options below)
- Production licensing: 12-month committed option (reserved GPU pool) or month-to-month staging -> production. Platform fee applies at production go-live unless otherwise negotiated.
- Discount mechanics: 20% off list model runtime for 12-mo commit; additional 10% discount on token rates after hitting 60% of committed throughput for two consecutive months. Platform fee discounts can be structured to step down at ramp milestones.

I've included two recommended commercial tracks in the attached MAP:
A) Committed (Recommended for predictable cost): 12-month reserved capacity (min commit: 4 x A100-equivalent nodes), platform fee $8,000/mo, 20% runtime discount upfront.
B) Pilot-first (Lower short-term commitment): 90-day pilot with usage pricing + deferred platform fee (platform fee begins on production go-live). Post-pilot, option to convert to a 12-mo commit with a retroactive discount applied to the first month after conversion.

Next steps: 1) Confirm pilot kickoff week; 2) Share procurement contact for term sheet; 3) Tell us any regulatory evidence (SOC2, encryption at rest, KMS) you need in SOW.

Thanks — attaching MAP_v3 and Term_Sheet_draft.
